description: Dimbulagala Pradeshiya Sabha - Declare that Mr. S. Rathnaweera of the Dimbulagala Pradeshiya Sabha has Vacated his Office of the member of that Pradeshiya  Sabha as he has been ceased to be a member of the United National Party
reasoning: This gazette notice specifically concerns the vacation of office by a member of the Dimbulagala Pradeshiya Sabha due to ceasing membership in a political party. This is a direct matter related to electoral processes and the status of an elected official under the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance, fitting the definition of an Elections Gazette (Type 7).
